4. Tail: Correctly marked as untestable due to framing.

I agree with all 'is_present' judgments. The Router was not too lenient; in fact, the scrutiny of the subtympanic shield demonstrates appropriate rigor.

I find no new artifacts. The image exhibits high structural coherence. The only minor note is that the lighting on the dewlap is slightly flat compared to the rest of the body, but this is likely a photographic artifact (shadowing) rather than an AI generation defect.
